g.title: Sheet.420
g.desc: The user wants to reach the company printer at 10.4.11.7, but...
g.text: The ISP sees only the outer IP header - traffic going from one public IP to another public IP.

g.title: Sheet.421
g.desc: The user wants to reach the company printer at 10.4.11.7, but...
g.text: The client takes the original packet with private IPs and wraps it inside a new packet.

g.title: Rectangle.439
g.desc: The VPN gateway later removes the outer header and delivers t...
g.text: The VPN gateway later removes the outer header and delivers the inner packet to the corp. network.

g.title: Sheet.425
g.text: When the VPN first establishes, it creates a vNIC adapter and receives a corporate private IP from the VPN gateway.
